Last year, Apple introduced a brand-new feature called AutoMix for Apple Music. With this year's iOS 27, the feature has received a major upgrade, delivering better transitions than ever.

iOS 27 中的 Apple Music AutoMix

Quick recap: AutoMix uses artificial intelligence to create DJ-like transitions between songs in Apple Music. According to Apple, the original version employed techniques such as "time-stretching and beat-matching" to achieve seamless transitions.

While AutoMix in iOS 26 was already impressive, most of its transition styles were rather similar and predictable.

Apple says AutoMix in iOS 27 "brings a whole new level of energy and fun to the experience, taking transitions to the next level and making listeners feel even more immersed."

Having tested it myself, I can confirm that Apple is right. AutoMix's transitions are noticeably more seamless and natural than before, and feel closer to a real DJ style. The 'underwater' sound effect that was AutoMix's default in iOS 26 has largely been replaced with more natural transitions, making the flow between songs much smoother.

iOS 27's AutoMix also remixes the endings and beginnings of songs, perfectly aligning the rhythm at the transition point. It also loops portions of the outro and intro to bridge the gap — and the overall sense of immersion is indeed a significant step up from before.

It's also worth noting that AutoMix has arrived on Apple Music for tvOS and HomePod as part of this year's software updates.

9to5Mac's take

AutoMix is a polarising feature — very much a love-it-or-hate-it kind of thing. Some people simply don't care for the various transition styles it applies, and that's perfectly fair.

Personally, though, I find the feature a lot of fun — especially when playing music at social gatherings and parties.

I really enjoy listening to how Apple Music moves between songs, particularly tracks that are wildly different in style. It adds a lot of flavour to the listening experience.

iOS 27 is now available to public beta testers and is set to launch officially later this year.

What are your thoughts on AutoMix in Apple Music? Have you noticed the improvements in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
